name: Soo-jin Jeong
source: Born December 31, 210 FE, in Hilo, Hawai'i, UPR, to OFS diplomats. Soo-jin is the longest-serving current pilot aboard the Nauvoo. she's counting down the days until she turns 21 and never has to pilot a mech again.
translation: Born December 31, 210 FE, in Hilo, Hawai'i, UPR, to OFS diplomats. Soo-jin is the longest-serving current pilot aboard the Nauvoo. she's counting down the days until she turns 21 and never has to pilot a mech again.
